revision_summary: Two minor wrong_ts quote fixes needed: (1) script_coverage[1] interest_question.customer_quote 'My electric bill keeps going up.' should be timestamped ~02:37-02:44, not 02:20 (02:20 is the rep's question, not the customer's answer). (2) script_coverage[7] tax_credit_qualifier.customer_quote 'No. It should be around that.' should be timestamped ~06:17-06:19, not 05:46 (05:46 is the rep saying 'everything looks good here on my end,' before the credit question is even asked at 05:46-06:02). Additionally: reclassify the 05:19 'tiny, tiny, tiny bit out of our bounds' moment as a distinct geographic/service-area ambiguity separate from the credit qualifier (it precedes the credit question and its content is about 'working with' the customer, not credit score) — do not conflate it with qualifiers.credit_qualifier. Soften or reframe cherry_pick_moments[4] (06:04, 'What's the score?') — this is better read as a benign qualifier clarification consistent with the schema's own open policy question on self-reported credit (qualifiers.credit_qualifier.spencer_operator_note), not primarily an objection_inversion_miss, since objection_inversion is schema-scoped to cost/time/interest objections. Correct the schema_reference on the non_standard_scenario_hold moment (03:42) — it is not an existing TBD protocols slot; label it as an emergent/ungrounded observation instead. Optionally add a positive cherry_pick_moments entry for the 40-year-residence correction at 01:23 given verify.residence_length is a named schema item. All other quotes and the outcome dispute are well-grounded and should remain as-is.
